{{Quote|Well, this is exciting! Do you know, Anakin, you're the first boyfriend my sister's ever brought home?|Sola Naberrie, to her future brother-in-law|<ref name="AOTCN">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Sola Naberrie''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. She was the elder daughter of [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee]] and [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal Naberrie]], the sister of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], as well as the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo]] and [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]]. She would later become the maternal aunt to [[Twin/Legends|twins]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].

==Biography==
[[File:SolaNaberrie1.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Sola, at dinner with her family]]
Sola met her future husband [[Darred Janren Naberrie|Darred Janren]], a young [[Architect/Legends|architect]], while studying at a [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[University/Legends|university]]. Shortly after her [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]], she had two daughters, [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo]] and [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja]]. Sola and Darred recognized the fact that the [[Naberrie family/Legends|Naberrie name]] was well-known within the social and [[Politics/Legends|political]] circles of Naboo, and therefore decided to keep it as the family name.<ref name="DB" />

Having settled happily into a domestic life, Sola worried about [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé's]] choice of life, wondering if her "little baby sister" would ever settle down and have [[Youngling/Legends|children]] of her own.<ref name="AOTCN" /> She also greatly enjoyed teasing Padmé about [[Gender/Legends|men]] who would make likely suitors for her, much to her sister's exasperation.<ref name="DB" /> Sola even told [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], her future brother-in-law, that he was "the first boyfriend" Padmé had ever brought home to the family.<ref name="AOTCDS" />

Shortly after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had ended, Sola, along with her family and thousands of other mourners, attended her sister's [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]].<ref name="Episode III" />

Her youngest daughter Pooja later became Naboo's [[Senator/Legends|representative]] in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

In 36 ABY, 68 years after the fall of the Empire, Sola and [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo]] were in for a surprise when Pooja brought before her [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] who served with her in the Imperial Senate as well as Leia's brother [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]]. Pooja revealed that Leia and her were first cousins and on seeing her niece, Sola noted how much she carried her mother's fierce determination, regal poise, and deep capacity for empathy. She also saw how Luke had inherited his father's kindness and gentleness, something that filled both her and her daughters with immense familial pride.
